title: On the integrability of the Kirchhoff-Pohozaev equation on tori
summary: In this paper we study the Kirchhoff-Pohozaev equation introduced in \cite{P2} and its constants of motion (see \cite{BoitiManfrin2025}, \cite{BoitiManfrin2026}) on $n$ dimensional tori. We show that these Hamiltonians are all in involution and we prove that they are generated by an infinite list of constants of motion which are all defined and in involution on a fixed phase space. Then we study the Kirchhoff-Pohozaev equation restricted to a finite Fourier support.
